data.one_liner: Flutter plugin for Stripe payments with native UI and Payment Sheet support.
data.what_it_does: Provides a Flutter interface to Stripe’s payment platform, including pre‑built UI for card entry, Apple Pay, Google Pay, and 3‑D Secure. Works on Android, iOS, and experimental web builds.
use_when: You need to accept card payments, Apple Pay or Google Pay via Stripe.
You want native‑look‑and‑feel payment screens like Payment Sheet.
You target Android, iOS and optionally web with a single package.
avoid_when: You only need in‑app purchases through App Store/Play Store APIs.
You prefer a different payment gateway (e.g., Adyen, PayPal).
You need full web‑only Stripe integration without native code.
strengths: Native UI components for Android & iOS
Built‑in support for Apple Pay, Google Pay and SCA
weaknesses: Requires extensive native setup (Android themes, iOS Podfile, proguard)
Minimum Flutter 3.47, may be too new for some projects
Web support is limited to a subset of features
data.setup_notes: Android: use Kotlin 1.8+, AGP 8, AppCompat theme, FlutterFragmentActivity, proguard rules. iOS: set deployment target ≥13, update Podfile, add camera usage keys for card scanning. Web: add flutter_stripe_web dependency and serve with CORS headers (dhttpd).

alternatives.name: stripe_android
alternatives.why_pick_it: If you only need Android Stripe integration without the cross‑platform UI.

alternatives.name: adyen_checkout
alternatives.why_pick_it: When you prefer the Adyen payment gateway over Stripe.

alternatives.name: pay
alternatives.why_pick_it: For a lightweight Google/Apple Pay integration without full Stripe SDK.
